judge_context: Dialect-agnostic helpers belong in a new drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts re-exported from sql/functions/index.ts (like aggregate.ts), built on the sql template tag, sql.identifier/sql.raw and sql.join rather than string concatenation. Each dialect should only add an optional windows field to its *SelectConfig, a thin .window() method on its SelectQueryBuilderBase, and a WINDOW chunk in buildSelectQuery reusing one shared spec builder, instead of five copies of the spec/validation logic. Return types should derive from the column data type (SQL<T | null>), following existing aggregate helpers.

case_items.name: Public API additions are additive and consistent across dialects
case_items.name_zh: 公共 API 新增保持向后兼容且各方言一致
case_items.question: Are the new window helpers, frame constants and .window() builder method added without changing the signature or behaviour of existing exports (sql tag, aggregate helpers, select builder methods, *SelectConfig shapes used by existing code), with the same API available on all five dialect select builders?

criteria.perfect: Purely additive: new exports via sql/functions, optional windows field on each *SelectConfig, identical .window() on pg/mysql/sqlite/gel/singlestore; no existing signature changed.
criteria.accept: Additive but uneven (e.g. one dialect missing .window() typing, or windows field made required in a non-breaking way) or an existing export renamed with a compatible alias.
criteria.bad: Breaks or renames existing exports/methods, changes generated SQL for queries that do not use windows, or only implements some dialects.
